data.title: KSrelief Distributes 102 Food Baskets to Displaced Families in Yemen's Taiz
data.content:
Taiz, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 102 food baskets on Thursday in Al-Masrakh District, Taiz Governorate, Yemen, benefiting 714 people from 102 families, including displaced and host families and households headed by women or with infants, elderly members, or people with special needs.
    The distribution is part of an emergency relief project for residents of Taiz and the Kingdom's relief efforts through KSrelief to help the Yemeni people through the humanitarian crisis.
    -- SPA
19:28 Local Time 16:28 GMT
